knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}

# for 60 & 61: manually updated subID column 
subinfo = data.frame(session_time = character(),
                     subID = character(),
                     task_1 = character(),
                     task_2 = character(),
                     strategic_cond_1 = character(),
                     strategic_cond_2 = character(),
                     false_feed_cond_1 = character(),
                     false_feed_cond_2 = character())

filelist = list.files(path="/Users/lunarneko/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/School/[Lab]/False feedback/false_feed_eeg/data_beh/data_raw/",pattern="*.csv",full.names = TRUE)
dflist = lapply(filelist, read.csv)


for (i in 1:length(dflist)) {
  df = dflist[[i]]
  
  # exclude subj with no EEG data
  if (str_detect(filelist[i],"NO EEG DATA 766812")) {
    #df$subID = "48_NO_EEG"  # the next subj is 48
    next
  } 
  
  time = df$date[1]
  
  if ("subID" %in% names(df)) {
    id = df$subID[1] %>% as.character()
    if (id == "NA" | is.na(id)) {
      stop("Missing subID! Manually fill in subID in csv file")
    }
    else if (id=="55adj") {
      id="55"
    } 
  }
  
  task_cond_marker = df %>% 
    mutate(i_row = row_number()) %>% 
    group_by(curr_task,curr_cond) %>% slice(1) %>%   # use slice() instead of unique() to keep original row number (order of blocks)
    select(i_row,subID,curr_task,n_cond,curr_cond) %>% arrange(i_row) %>% 
    filter(curr_task %in% c("false_feed","strategic")) 
  
  task_order = c(task_cond_marker$curr_task[1],task_cond_marker$curr_task[3]) 
  
  prob_conds = task_cond_marker %>% filter(curr_task == "strategic") %>% arrange(i_row)
  prob_cond_order = c(prob_conds$curr_cond[1],prob_conds$curr_cond[2])
  
  fpf_conds = task_cond_marker %>% filter(curr_task == "false_feed") %>% arrange(i_row)
  fpf_cond_order = c(fpf_conds$curr_cond[1],fpf_conds$curr_cond[2])


  
  this_sub = data.frame(subID = id, session_time = time,
                        task_1 = task_order[1],
                        task_2 = task_order[2],
                        strategic_cond_1 = prob_cond_order[1],
                        strategic_cond_2 = prob_cond_order[2],
                        false_feed_cond_1 = fpf_cond_order[1],
                        false_feed_cond_2 = fpf_cond_order[2])
  subinfo = rbind(subinfo,this_sub)
  
}

subinfo = subinfo %>% arrange(session_time,subID) %>% 
  rename(sub = subID) %>% 
  mutate(task_0 = "true_feed") %>% 
  relocate(task_0, .before=task_1)

write.csv(subinfo,"subinfo_for_eeg.csv",row.names=FALSE)

```
